summary: The Lounge is a self-hosted web IRC client that runs on your own infrastructure. It maintains a persistent connection to chat networks so you can access your channels and direct messages from a browser.
goodFor: It suits individuals or teams who rely on IRC for communication and want a centralized, always-on web client accessible from multiple devices.
watchOut: You will need to manage user authentication and ensure your server is properly secured, as running an exposed web chat client carries inherent access risks.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running a Docker container, where you will need to map persistent storage for user configurations and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
